errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 'суровини и материали' (raw materials and materials) category is blue. According to the chart and its legend, this category is represented by the red slice. The blue slice represents 'потребителски стоки' (consumer goods).
The description uses the term 'инвестиционни благосъстояние' (investment welfare), which is an incorrect transcription of the label in the legend, which is 'инвестиционни блага' (investment goods).

errors.evidence: The value for the category 'инвестиционни блага' (investment goods) is stated as 11.3%, but the chart clearly labels this green slice as 24.3%. The value 11.3% corresponds to the 'енергийни ресурси' (energy resources) category.
